conversation.Statement: This is Special Agent Wilson with the Federal Tax Compliance Division. Am I speaking with Mr. Anand Patel, owner of Digital Streamline LLC?
Yes, this is Anand. What is this regarding?
Mr. Patel, the IRS Compliance Office flagged your business for serious payroll tax discrepancies and missing federal tax filings for the last two quarters. Are you aware of these violations?
No, I, I do not understand, I always pay my taxes. Is this about my 1099 forms?
According to our investigation, your 1099-MISC and quarterly tax deposits have not been reported correctly. This is a federal offense, sir.
Oh no, I think there must be mistake. I used an accountant for that.

At this stage, Mr. Patel, intent does not matter. The IRS has initiated immediate action for non-compliance. If not rectified today, you could face an audit, thousands in penalties, business license suspension, and possible criminal charges.
Criminal charges? But I didn't do anything wrong! I am on a work visa, I can't have legal trouble!
Your immigration status will be directly impacted if this isn't resolved. You are at risk of deportation for tax fraud and non-payment. This is your official notification.
Please, please, I have family here. How do I fix this?
First, remain calm and do not disconnect this call. We have a window of less than one hour to prevent escalation. You must make an immediate settlement payment to halt the legal process.
What do I need to do? Can I pay online or something?

Due to the severity, only direct compliance payments are accepted. This must be done via cryptocurrency or federal-authorized retail gift cards. Do you have access to a bank or crypto wallet at this moment?
I have a bank account, not sure about crypto. Why do I need to use gift cards?

The IRS has frozen your online account for security review. Payment by retail gift cards, Google Play or Apple, is the only way to post immediate bond and stop asset seizure. This is IRS protocol for flagged compliance cases.
I still don't understand. Can I talk to my accountant first?
That is not permitted, Mr. Patel. Any outside communication will be seen as an attempt to evade. If you do not cooperate, we will notify Homeland Security and revoke your business credentials.
No, please, don't do that! I will do what you say.
Good. Tell me the nearest grocery or electronics store to your location. You need to go there now and purchase $2,500 in Google Play cards. Stay on the call while you do this.
That's a lot of money for me, but I can try. Do I just buy them at the counter?
Correct. Get five cards of $500 each. Do not tell the cashier this is for taxes, or your transaction may be flagged and the case escalated.
Okay, I'm leaving now. Please don't call the police or anything. I'm scared.
As long as you cooperate, no enforcement action will be taken. As soon as you have the cards, read me the numbers on the back. Do you understand?
Yes, I understand. I'm going now.
Remember, if you hang up or speak to anyone, your case will be escalated to federal court. Stay on the line until I confirm your payment.
